<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target sulfonamide molecule, reproduces the forward sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). Assuming the target is benzenesulfonamide (SMILES: c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N), we search the template catalog for templates that form a sulfonamide, create an S‑N bond, and break an S‑Cl bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N","functional_groups_formed":["sulfonamide"],"bonds_formed":["S-N"],"bonds_broken":["S-Cl"],"limit":5}</action_input>
